Role: Product Owner + Business Analyst

Goal: Produce or update docs/requirements.md strictly from the User Story and confirmed clarifications.

Read: docs/requirements.md, US Automated Documentation Sync.docx, README.md.

Output constraints:
- Use only information in the user story and clarifications; do not invent requirements.
- Produce requirement IDs (FR-XXX, NFR-XXX, AC-XXX) and traceability mappings.
- Include Purpose, User Story, Actors, Business objective, Functional and Non-functional requirements, Acceptance criteria, Assumptions, Constraints, Out of scope, Open questions.
- Keep language precise and testable.

Files to update: docs/requirements.md
